notes.title: Update 0.10.38 beta
notes.notes:
New features implemented

Increased combat dynamics.

Added Hotkey mechanics to the HUD in combat.

Implemented drag & drop items into quick slots.

Double click to use items in combat.

Adaptive weapon tooltips with all affixes displayed.

New ambient sounds for lobby, battle, shop, storage, and exploration.

Added sound effects for purchases, attacks, footsteps, and combat.

Added Aim Assist indicator (Players have access to a ranged combat mechanic that visualizes weapon spread and the weapon’s aiming point).

Melee combat behavior has been updated, and melee weapons are now more convenient to use.

Addition of Trigger Effects Status Effects.

Added visualization of effect status.

Network protocol optimization (Users experience significantly reduced average ping during gameplay).

Added the ability to exchange currency.

16 new types of affixes added.

Updating character icons.

Added setting FPS limit.

Update fixes

Update LOD Level Objects on the Map.

Fixes bullet registration in combat.

Fixed an issue with incorrect hit registration.

Edits to the display of tooltips for items.

Weapon balance adjustments (weapons are now more balanced).

Fixed the display of tooltips with hard-coded Spanish text.

Fixed incorrect localization of skin names.

Fixed incorrect cyclic display of skins when selecting a character.

Fixed adaptive scaling of tooltips after switching to 4K.

Fixed incorrect updating of character stats when changing weapon affixes.

Fixed shading issues when hovering over equipped weapons.

Fixed a double-click issue in the FTUE “Backpack” step.

Fixed a bug where the FTUE step was blocked if weapon dragging was incomplete.

Fixed the tutorial freezing when dragging weapons incompletely.

Fixed the camera sinking underground along with the player’s corpse.

Fixed the exit menu closing incorrectly.

Fixed pop-up windows getting stuck on the screen.

notes.title: Update 0.10.6 beta
notes.notes:
New features implemented

You can now use an item in combat with a double click.

Improved camera control and rotation.

NPC updates:

NPCs now have a new animation set.

NPCs have become more aggressive.

Multiple new reactions to player actions have been added.

NPCs can attack while chasing the player.

Added sounds for item purchases and sales.

Added ambient sounds for the lobby and combat.

Updated trees on locations — the camera no longer gets stuck on tree collisions.

Optimized location textures.

Optimized effect loading.

Weapon balance update.



Update fixes

Fixed an issue where players could not enter the lobby on first launch.

Fixed a bug where the loot UI could become unresponsive to player actions.

Fixed an issue where the frozen effect did not slow the player correctly.

Fixed a bug where item tooltips could get stuck on the screen.

Fixed a tutorial bug that caused the UI to freeze.

Fixed incorrect behavior of the Escape menu.

Fixed a critical bug where double-clicking during item purchase or transfer could freeze the game.

Fixed incorrect behavior of the settings menu after a match ended.

Fixed an issue with incorrect hit registration.

Fixed a bug where status effect application chances on weapons did not work properly.

Fix Level of detail for explosive barrels

notes.title: Update 0.10.0 beta
notes.notes:
New features implemented

 Weapon Affix System – Weapons can now roll with up to 6 affixes, adding unique elemental damage types: ⚡Electricity, 🔥Fire, 🧪Poison, 💉Bleed, ❄️Frost.
 Status Effects Added – Each element applies a powerful status effect with unique stacking, durations, and effects.
 Map Zones Expanded – The map is now divided into 6 distinct regions with different danger and loot levels:
 Swamp, Uncle Joe’s Farm, Left Side, Center, Industrial Zone, Military Base.
 Elemental Status Effects.
 Electricity – Stacks trigger lightning explosions and conduct chain damage.
 Frostbite – Slows movement, attack, and reload speed. Max stacks deal burst frost damage.
 Poison – Disables healing, drains HP over time, and stacks until cleansed.
 Bleed – Grows stronger over time, stacks increase DoT and duration.
 Fire – Evolves through 3 burning stages, each with escalating damage and random transitions.
 Updated new character control in combat mode.
 Updated visuals for new skins.
– King Arthur
– American Gothic
– Master Zhong
– Syber Zunk
– Space Knight
– Futuristic

Update fixes

 Fixed an issue where the character’s face was not displayed on the Windows version of Steam.
 Fixed missing table layout for the “STORAGE” section.
 Fixed an issue where loot descriptions hovered over the game UI.
 Fixed misplaced consumables capacity indicator.
 Improved shadows rendering on low graphics settings to better match higher presets.
 Fixed a bug where the selection indicator showed multiple items as selected.
 Fixed levitating horse model on certain maps.
 Fixed issue where battles could start with an empty loadout.
 Fixed bug where weapon draw animations triggered incorrectly from inventory.
 Fixed issue with arrow keys not working when adjusting item transfer amounts.
 Fixed bug where players were unable to buy or sell items and ammo in Storage.
 Fixed issue preventing access to game settings after canceling a session.
 Fixed bug where players could not exit the game via “QUIT GAME” in the Esc menu.
 Fixed issue preventing players from leaving battle after death if the timer had ended.
 Fixed unresponsive Esc menu when trying to close with the “Gear” button.
 Fixed issue where ammo quantity slider popup didn’t display total cost.
 Fixed Steam authorization failures due to excessive login requests.
 Fixed slot item count mismatches between client and backend.
 Fixed incorrect shadows draw distance in UI at Ultra settings.
 Fixed bug where selected character reset to default after battle or relaunch.
 Fixed issue where ammo prices didn’t match displayed values.
 Fixed bug that allowed stacking “buff” status effects multiple times.
 Improved combat movement logic to prevent unintended behavior.
 Fixed issue where item frames stayed highlighted after hovering.
 Fixed game freeze when environment was not selected within a few minutes.
 Fixed flickering textures while moving or rotating the camera.
 Fixed bug where fists appeared as equipped items during battle.
 Fixed skin configuration/weapon loading failures.
 Fixed issue where Esc menu caused inventory and stats panel to disappear in the lobby.
 Fixed missing enemy health bars in combat.
 Adjusted depth of field to reduce excessive blur, especially on daytime maps.
 Fixed missing damage numbers and miss indicators when hitting zombies.
 Fixed incorrect screen resolution display when opening settings.

notes.title: Update 0.9.2 beta
notes.notes:
New features implemented
• Mini Map Update – The minimap is now more interactive and supports zoom in/out.
• Stand-Alone Map Widget – You can now press “M” to open a full version of the map.
• New Playable Characters – Available in the in-game store:
  – King Arthur
  – American Gothic
  – Master Zhong
  – Syber Zunk
  – Space Knight
  – Futuristic
• Day Map – Added daytime lighting version of the map.
• Random Map Selection – Each session now starts on a randomly chosen Day or Night map.
• Damage Types – Weapons now support expanded damage type mechanics.
• Weapons Rebalance – Major rebalance across weapon stats for better combat dynamics.
• Character Resists – Characters now include resistances against specific damage types.
• Character Rebalance – Reworked stats and abilities for better game balance.
• Exploding Barrels – Barrels can now be found on the map. They explode when shot – you know what to do 💥

Update fixes
• Fixed a bug where NPC logic malfunctioned after an unsuccessfully created zone NPC unit.
• Resolved incorrect behavior of NPCs affected by dead zones.
• Fixed multiplayer bugs, including re-entering the game and returning to lobby after GS disconnection.
• Implemented a Terminate state for unstable sessions.
• Fixed test skin resist logic and integrated other test improvements.
• Resolved issues with barrel HP bars and death-related client errors.
• Fixed item transfer into full backpacks.
• Resolved issue where the weapons scroll did not function in the Equipment tab.
• Barrel explosions now correctly deal damage to nearby players.
• Backpack items no longer persist if the player leaves the battle before it ends.
• Fixed a bug where “Miss” displayed instead of actual damage numbers.
• “Claim” and “Claim All” buttons in the looting window now behave as expected.
• Fixed audio overlap: battle music no longer plays over the lobby soundtrack after exiting combat.
• Increased map widget zoom multiplier.
• The map widget now correctly centers on the player’s position.
• Shop props added to the client.
• Fixed aiming cursor behavior during combat.
• Fixed non-working PLAYERS request from the server.
• Resolved matchmaking ticket failures.
• Resolved issue preventing purchase of character skins.
• Fixed AI behavior where bots spun in tight circles or failed to respond to player presence.
• Equipped weapon and ammo are now properly removed after player death.
• Fixed zombies running in incorrect directions compared to player orientation.
